## NexusNova Flagship Review

This PR must comply with the repository's NexusNova Global Flagship Standard.

### Required checks
- [ ] Existing functionality was inspected and preserved unless intentionally changed.
- [ ] Primary user flow works end-to-end.
- [ ] No fake/dead/decorative-only primary controls.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, retry, cancel, and success states are handled where relevant.
- [ ] Responsive behavior checked at 360x800, 390x844, and 412x915 where applicable.
- [ ] Media previews preserve correct aspect ratio and do not silently crop.
- [ ] Runtime/automated QA was actually run.
- [ ] Regression impact was checked.
- [ ] Final claims are backed by concrete evidence.

### Evidence
Describe the exact tests, runs, screenshots, or artifacts that prove the change works.

### Blockers
List any unresolved blocker. Do not mark the change complete while a release-blocking issue remains.
